svg.title: Direct convergence trace
svg.text: y = log10(off(B) / ||B₀||F), x = applied rotations. Direct samples only.
Equal rotations do not mean equal time: maximum-pivot scans inspect every upper-triangle entry.
Zero samples are shown at display floor 6.77E-24 and labelled zero; this is not a measured positive error.
Trace compaction preserves initial/final samples; operation counts remain exact.
